purpose: Example brief for a waitlist site. It shows the shape and the defaults only. Every idea-specific value below belongs to a made-up product and must be replaced by what the person says in the interview.

site.name: Mealwise
site.one_liner: A weekly dinner plan for busy families, with the shopping list done for you.

audience.icp: Parents with two or more children who cook most weeknight dinners and are tired of deciding what to make.
audience.alternatives: Recipe websites, meal-kit boxes, or deciding on the way home from work.

success_target.note: Example number. The person sets their own.

hypothesis: Busy parents will join a waitlist for a weekly dinner plan with a ready shopping list.

blocks.headline: Dinner, decided.
blocks.subheadline: Mealwise plans your week of family dinners and writes the shopping list, so you never again stand in the kitchen at 5 o'clock asking what to make.
blocks.note: Founding families keep their price for life

background.mood: A bright family kitchen table in morning light, a bowl of fruit, warm wood.

blocks.heading: A week of dinners, in one view
blocks.text: See the plan, swap a meal, and get the list.

image.label: Concept preview
image.description: A mock-up of a weekly plan with five dinners and a shopping list beside it.

items.title: A plan in one minute
items.text: Tell us who is eating and what they like. Get a full week.

items.title: The list writes itself
items.text: Every ingredient, grouped by aisle, with quantities for your family.

items.title: Swap anything
items.text: Not a fan of Tuesday? Change a meal and the list updates.

items.title: Made for picky eaters
items.text: Set dislikes and allergies once and they stay out of every plan.

form.privacy_note: We will only email you about Mealwise. You can leave any time.
form.success_message: Thanks, you're in. We'll email you when the first places open.

claims.text: Founding families keep their price for life.

rules: No stock or generated photos or screenshots are fetched or invented.
The hero background and the product preview start as neutral placeholders, the preview labelled 'Concept preview'.
The owner uploads both through the owner area and gives each a description.

look.accent_note: Choose one accent that suits a warm family brand and record it.

owner.sign_in: One owner, from environment configuration. The email and password hash are supplied when the site is deployed.
areas: signups: totals, goal progress, breakdowns, list, CSV download
page content: Hero, Preview, Benefits, Waitlist, Footer

storage.photos: A storage adapter: local disk for development, Vercel Blob when deployed

stack: See the Builder's knowledge/stack.json. Those decisions are fixed.
not_in_this_version: Testimonials, customer logos or user counts
assumptions: Everything about Mealwise is made up for this example.
The thank-you message is a default; the person can change it.
